name: ERCC excision repair 1, endonuclease non-catalytic subunit

function.text: ERCC1 encodes DNA excision repair protein ERCC-1. Annotated molecular activities include damaged DNA binding and single-stranded DNA binding. It participates in DNA repair and negative regulation of telomere maintenance.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to cerebrooculofacioskeletal syndrome 4 (autosomal recessive).

somatic.text: This gene is included in cancer-panel definitions, but a disease-specific somatic association has not been assigned from the alteration-context sources reviewed for this draft.

germline_associations.mechanism: Autosomal recessive; definitive GenCC assertion from G2P. Allele-specific mechanism requires review.
